pages.title: Privacy policy
pages.intro: We use the information you provide to respond to your sewer line request. This policy describes the form information and form tracker used on this website. Avoid including sensitive personal information in the request details.

sections.heading: Information submitted
paragraphs: The form collects your name, phone, email when provided and description of the sewer problem. It also includes the site and page identity to keep your request connected with the page you used. Airchatty external tracking processes these requests and related form events.

sections.heading: Use and sharing
paragraphs: Request information may be shared with service providers involved in responding to your inquiry. We do not promise a particular service provider or result. Call the contact number shown on this site if you have questions about your submitted request.

sections.heading: Your choices
paragraphs: You may choose to call instead of sending the form. Browser privacy settings may limit some tracking, and third-party services have their own policies. Do not submit payment details or identity documents through this form.

pages.intro: This website provides sewer line information and a way to request contact. The information does not replace an inspection or advice from a qualified plumbing professional. Using the site does not create a service agreement.
